::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-buggy"}
Fast, light and everywhere. Most of what Grubstake takes from you, it takes with buggies, and the buggy circling just outside your guns is its prowl.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-shotgun-hand"}
Grubstake's infantry, cheap and quick. Shotgun hands do the work of a raid: they take your machines apart and carry them off.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-harrier"}
Scrap and a gun, sent in numbers over your walls from Grubstake's first level. Gun turrets bring them down before they reach anything.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-slug"}
Grubstake buys them once your vehicles have killed enough of its raiders. A slug hits hard and seldom, so troopers on foot make it work for every kill.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-sapper"}
Grubstake fields sappers once your infantry has cost it enough. A squad that keeps its spacing loses less to each throw.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-scavenger"}
It dies with its target. Gun turrets by your artillery bring it down on the way in.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-dozer"}
A wall that has stopped Grubstake's raids often enough meets a dozer, with shotgun hands behind it.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-flak-buggy"}
Scrap flak that bursts in the air. Grubstake buys it once your fliers and combat robots have cost it enough.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-scorcher"}
Grubstake buys it against turret lines. It has to come close to burn, so rockets and artillery get their chance on the way in.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-howitzer-truck"}
Only a camp that landed with a grudge brings one, and only against a wall your robots keep mending.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-hauler"}
It builds Grubstake's new lots, carries its loot and drives the ore home from its claims. One killed on the road spills what it carries.
:::
